notes.title: New version v1.9 has arrived!
notes.content:
New version v1.9 has arrived!

"Back to the basics, more content, challenge everything!"

Here are the key takeaways from this update:
Game system:
1. The resolution of the game has been increased from 1280x720 to 1600x900, and with it, the world of the game has become bigger!
2. Removed the player's movement inertia and enjoy the instantaneous operation!
3. Players who have become larger or smaller now have visual numerical hints.
4. The player's bubble attack can now be continuously grown and strengthened!
5. The player's acceleration will consume weight, the strength of the acceleration increases with the level, the player's speed is related to the weight, prepare to lose weight!
6. In two-player mode, you can choose to turn on players to use bubbles to deal damage with each other!
7. Player 2 can now be added or removed at any time in the game!
8. Players can now defeat the sea monster and become the true king of the water!
9. Added anti-aliasing and volume settings.
10. Game settings data is now saved.
11. Reset the game's UI.

new content:
1. Added 4 new monsters that will bring different treasures for players to grow!
2. Added 5 new items to enhance players during gameplay.
3. Added 3 new dangerous weapons that will fall from the sky, be careful!
4. Re-added the animation of the plant environment in the water, and the scene is more vivid.
5. Added some special effects (evolution, devouring props)

And some other details.

notes.title: New version v1.7 is out!
notes.content:
New version v1.7 is out!
Here are the mainly new updates:

4.The background is modified now!
-I try to help players to confirm their positions better under the water and not be lost or boring easily.❤
-Players can alos customize the background by replacing the game file:"KOW\res\env\background\background.png".(remember to use the same name and format)
5.The underlying engine has been refactored.
-The speed system has been rebuilt. It could be a whole new experience.
-The game now runs at the same speed on computers with different refresh rates.
-This is prepared for players to play together on different computers.(Coming soon)
6.Player1 press "J" to speed up and Player2 press numpad "0" to speed up.
-When accelerated, the speed will be up to 1.8 times.
7.Fix some bugs. Here are mainly ones:
-The behavior of fishes to doge monsters is fixed and is more rational now!(will not misguide players anymore)
-The effect of fish meat has been revised.
